_claudeResetCredits: The usage dashboard reads each Claude seat's banked reset credits (read-only; at most one call per seat per 6 hours). Set to false to switch that off entirely.
_seatWeights: How many regular seats each seat counts as in the usage dashboard's pooled numbers (default 1; 0 leaves a seat out). Per provider (claude, codex, grok, gemini), by seat letter, e.g. {"codex": {"B": 5}} for a seat on a plan 5x the others. Wins over planWeights. Leave empty if all your seats are the same size.
_planWeights: Same, by the plan the provider reports for the seat (Codex only today: the dashboard's Codex table shows each seat's plan, and warns when seats on different plans are still counted equally). Providers do not publish exact multipliers, so you state them, e.g. {"codex": {"team": 1, "pro": 5}}. The table's 'measured' line is a rough check from your own usage.
